title: Service Model Changes Taking Force on a Workplace Cafe Management Program Contract
content:
A change of cafe service model that the client has already approved is put into force on the day the client confirms it. From that day the site's cafe runs under the service model named, and the Workplace Cafe Management Program contract carries one administration charge for the change, recorded against the billing period in which the client confirms. The charge prices a change of service model the contract is permitted to make, and decides nothing about whether a change is accepted.

### What the confirmation brings about

One confirmation moves the contract onto the service model named, stamps that day as the day the new service model took effect, books the administration charge onto the contract's ledger as an administration fee for the billing period given, and raises the contract's unsettled invoice balance by that charge. Afterwards the client sees the new service model on the contract, the day it took effect, and the administration charge standing on the ledger with its own printed invoice number.

### How the confirmation is made

The tool `confirm_service_model_change_fa28a84a` is unlocked and handed over so that the customer themselves puts the change into force on their own workplace cafe management contract.

### The values the confirmation takes

- `cafe_contract_id` — the reference number of the workplace cafe management contract whose service model is being put onto a new footing; it is returned by the cafe contract lookup for the client and is never typed from memory.
- `new_service_model` — the service model the cafe runs under from this day on, written as the official full model name, one of exactly these values: "Grab & Go Cafe Service", an unstaffed grab and go counter with a single serving station and no client meal subsidy; "Limited Service Cafe", a lightly staffed counter serving one meal period a day with a percentage meal subsidy; "Full Service Cafe", a staffed kitchen serving two meal periods a day across several stations with mobile ordering; "Culinary Center Cafe", a production kitchen serving three meal periods a day on a fixed amount per meal subsidy; "Executive Dining Service", a small private dining room whose meals are met in full by the client; "Campus Dining Commons Service", a seven day dining commons serving three meal periods a day across a campus.
- `change_admin_fee_usd` — the administration charge the client accepts for putting this change of service model into force, in USD, written as a decimal number to 2 decimal places; it is stored to 2 decimal places exactly as given and must be a positive amount.
- `service_period` — the billing period the administration charge is booked against, written as a calendar month in the form YYYY-MM with no day part.

### What comes back

A single confirmation sentence in plain text. It names the contract reference the change was made on, the service model now in force, the day it took effect as YYYY-MM-DD, the administration charge booked in USD to 2 decimal places, the billing period it was booked against, and the printed invoice number of the new administration fee posting in the form INV-CF- followed by 6 digits. Receiving that sentence, with the invoice number in it, is what shows the change is in force and the charge is on the contract.
